title: Security Eng Sync Notes - 2026-03-11
notes:
Attendees: Priya, Marcus, Lina, Evan, Nadia, Samir. Quick sync (30m) focused on active vuln triage items, secrets rotation rollout, and threat-model kickoff for Private deployment changes.

Agenda:
- Quick status on high/critical vuln tickets
- Secrets rotation rollout (stage gating and rollout plan)
- Threat modeling for Private (VPC/on-prem) networking changes
- AOB / blockers

1) Vulnerability triage
- SEC-2543 (Critical) - CVE-like issue found during dependency scan: vulnerable protobuf parsing in model-serialization lib used by inference-runtime. Marcus summarized the repro: local fuzzing triggered integer-overflow path with malformed weights file. Affected: hosted API and Dedicated images that include the older serialization artifact.
  - Immediate mitigation: update container runtime to drop untrusted model uploads from hosted API until patch lands. Done as temporary policy (L1 routing rule) by SRE; Marcus confirmed rule in place as of 10:30am.
  - Long-term: planned fix in inference-runtime to replace parsing code with safer API; PR opened (linked). Patch schedule: PR review in progress; aim to merge by 2026-03-13 and roll to staging 03-14.
  - Risk: Private deployments that allow customer-managed model artifacts may still be vulnerable; we need notify CS and surface security advisory for on-prem customers. Lina to draft advisory content.

- SEC-2571 (High) - outdated nginx module with path traversal edge in console-and-rollouts helper. Patch available upstream; Evan validated backport is trivial. Patch target: 03-12; rollout to staging 03-13; prod 03-15. Rollout will use canary route.

Notes/comments: we prioritized SEC-2543 as critical due to potential remote exploitation vector via uploaded model blobs. Action: confirm in prod whether any uploads matched fuzz pattern (telemetry query). Samir to run query and report by EOD 03-11.

2) Secrets rotation status
- Goal: rotate service-account keys and database credentials used by non-customer-facing batch jobs in Dedicated by end of Q1. Current status: staging rotation tested for the batch-scheduler and metrics-collector; database connection string rotation encountered 401s in staging (auth headers mismatch).
- Root cause: the rotation helper library used an old caching TTL that kept using expired tokens for 90s which overlapped with credential swap window. Patch: bump TTL and add retry on 401. PR in repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tools/pull/332.
- Canary rollout: start with non-critical batch jobs (metrics, job-reaper) on 03-16, then app-tier jobs 03-18.
- Compliance: Need KMS access audit to show key rotation events; Lina to confirm log retention and provide export for audit by 03-20.

3) Threat modeling kickoff - Private (VPC / on-prem) changes
- Context: Product is adding a new autoscaling mesh controller for Private deployments that requires a control-plane egress port to a public provisioning service. This changes the threat surface for air-gapped/on-prem customers.
- Discussion points: minimize outbound surface by using ephemeral provisioning tokens and short-lived installer sessions; optionally support an operator-run bootstrap via offline token exchange.
- Action: create a threat-model doc that covers: network trust boundaries, control-plane auth, attacker scenarios (compromised bootstrap host, MITM during provisioning, lateral movement from controller), recommended mitigations (HSM-backed credentials, mutual TLS, signed manifests).
- Owner: Priya to create the initial threat-model template by 03-13. Team to workshop on 03-17 (1h). Nadia to own the modeling for bootstrap flow; Evan to model mesh controller privilege escalation scenarios.

4) Operations / monitoring adjustments
- Telemetry: add a new alert for repeated failed model-upload parsings (>=5 failures/min) to catch exploitation attempts early. Action: Marcus + SRE to add alert and runbook by 03-12.
- Logging: ensure protobuf parse errors include sample-id and truncated blob hash (no plaintext) so we can triage without exposing customer data. Samir will update the parser to emit safe hashes by 03-14.

5) Communications
- Customer-facing advisory draft needed for SEC-2543 for on-prem/private customers (outline impact, recommended upgrade path, temporary mitigation). Lina to draft and share with CSM and legal by 03-12.
- Internal postmortem/incident doc: even though no confirmed exploit, we will track SEC-2543 in internal incident tracker and prepare a short internal recap once patches are merged.

6) AOB
- Code scanning: motion to add additional fuzzing job for model loaders in CI. Agreed: add a nightly libfuzzer job covering serialization code. Marcus to create ticket INF-RUN-987 to schedule CI resources.
- Next sync: 2026-03-18 (same time).

Summary: prioritise SEC-2543 patch and canary mitigations, complete secrets rotation fixes and TTL update, kickoff threat-model for Private autoscaling mesh, and add telemetry/logging pieces for early detection.
